name: Google sign-in
description: Signs a Google Drive account in through Google's own authorization endpoint.

codes.google_drive_oauth.bad_reply: Google sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.google_drive_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished. Start it again.
codes.google_drive_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Google. A Workspace administrator can also block it.
codes.google_drive_oauth.flow_unsupported: Google Drive is signed in through the browser, not with a device code.
codes.google_drive_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.google_drive_oauth.refresh_refused: Google no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
